page.content:
Perfect-haired scientist who comes to study Night Vale and stays for Cecil.

How Carlos the Scientist connects

  • Character: Cecil Palmer — Cecil loves Carlos; they later marry.
  • Location: Night Vale — Carlos comes to Night Vale to study the town and stays.

What is Carlos the Scientist?

Carlos is the scientist whose hair Cecil cannot stop mentioning, who arrives with a team to measure the town and becomes Cecil's husband and the show's long-running love story.

Key threads lead to Cecil Palmer and Night Vale.
